newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq says March short interest 1.4 bln shares.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq says March short interest 1.4 bln shares.

text.p: Nasdaq said Tuesday that as of mid-March, open short interest in 4,058 securities quoted on the screen-based exchange totalled 1.4 billion shares, compared to 1.3 billion shares for the same securities in February.
The March short interest represents 2.41 days' average daily Nasdaq share volume for the period, compared to 2.21 days in Fegruary it said.
The short interest position for each Nasdaq security reflect the total shares sold short by all broker-dealers, regardless of their exchange affiliations, Nasdaq said.

In the Nasdaq SmallCap Market, short interest in 1,435 securities totalled 51.1 million for March, compared to 52.1 million shares in 1,437 for February. This represents 0.95 days' average daily volume, compared to February's 0.85 days, it said.

Short interest in all Nasdaq stocks for March -- 5,493 securities -- totalled 1.44 billion shares, compared with 5,522 stocks or 1.34 billion shares in February. This represents 2.28 days' average daily volume, compared to February's 2.08 days, it said.
The figures for March include all short interest positions reported February 18 through March 11 and settled as of March 14, it said.
A short sale is the sale of a security not owned by the seller or any sale that is consummated by the delivery of a security borrowed by, or for the account of, the seller.
